newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 2-day system repurchases.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 2-day system repurchases.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system on Tuesday via two-day system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokeswoman confirmed.
At the time of the operation, Fed funds traded at 6-1/2 percent, above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate.

Analysts had expected the action, citing the need to counter reserve pressures related to the end of the year, to the end of the two-week bank reserve maintenance period, and to settlement of the two- and five-year notes that the Treasury auctioned last week.
